title: Bill Payment Service form is displayed
preconditions: Customer is logged in to the web banking application
steps: Navigate to the Bill Payment page
Verify that the form contains fields for payee name, address, city, state, zip, phone, account number (entered twice), amount, and a 'from' account
expected: The form is displayed with all required fields

title: Missing payee fields show validation messages
preconditions: Customer is logged in to the web banking application
steps: Navigate to the Bill Payment page
Leave a required payee field blank
Submit the form
expected: An error message is shown next to the blank field

title: Account number entries do not match
preconditions: Customer is logged in to the web banking application
steps: Navigate to the Bill Payment page
Enter different account numbers in the two account number fields
Submit the form

title: Amount is not a number
preconditions: Customer is logged in to the web banking application
steps: Navigate to the Bill Payment page
Enter a non-numeric value in the amount field
Submit the form

title: Successful payment shows confirmation message
preconditions: Customer is logged in to the web banking application and has sufficient funds in the selected account
steps: Navigate to the Bill Payment page
Enter valid payee information and account numbers
Enter a valid amount
Submit the form
expected: Bill Payment Complete with payee name, amount, and from-account is displayed

title: Account with insufficient funds is selected
preconditions: Customer is logged in to the web banking application and has an account with a balance of 0
steps: Navigate to the Bill Payment page
Select the account with insufficient funds
Enter valid payee information and account numbers
Enter a valid amount greater than the account balance
Submit the form
